title: How Much Velocity Does Off-Ball Space Value Need? A Broadcast-Viewport Benchmark
abstract: arXiv:2609.10801v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Velocity-aware pitch control is standard, but under a broadcast viewport half the players are off screen and on-screen velocities come from a drifting calibration. We ask at which layer of broadcast off-ball analysis velocity changes the answer. Inheriting our off-screen imputation protocol (three Metrica matches, 44 m viewport, block-bootstrap CIs), we score four velocity regimes -- none, viewport-legal observed, true-for-visible, true-for-all -- against a velocity-aware ground truth at three layers: imputation, the control surface, and team verdicts. Velocity is nearly useless for imputation (-0.2 pp against a 12--14 pp velocity-free surface MAE), first-order for the surface (-1.5 to -1.8 pp, 11--15% of that MAE), and ten times smaller for verdicts (-0.12 to -0.19 pp). The velocity that matters is the visible channel: perfect occluded-player velocity adds 2--6% of the visible gain, and no last-seen decay policy we tested exceeds that

translated_title: 无球空间价值需要多少速度信息？一个广播视角基准测试
translated_abstract: 速度感知的球场控制已成为标准做法，但在广播视角下，约一半的球员处于画面之外，且画面内球员的速度来自漂移的标定。我们要探究的问题是：在广播无球分析的哪个层面，速度信息会改变结论。继承我们此前的画面外插补协议（三场 Metrica 比赛数据、44 米视口、块自助法置信区间），我们在三个层面——插补、控制曲面和球队判定——上，将四种速度方案（无速度、视口内合法观测速度、可见球员真实速度、全部球员真实速度）与速度感知的真实标准进行对比评分。结果显示，速度对插补几乎无用（相比 12–14 个百分点的无速度控制曲面 MAE，仅贡献 -0.2 个百分点），对控制曲面具有一阶重要性（-1.5 至 -1.8 个百分点，占该 MAE 的 11–15%），而对球队判定的影响则小十倍（-0.12 至 -0.19 个百分点）。真正重要的速度来自可见通道：完美还原被遮挡球员的速度仅增加可见增益的 2–6%，而我们测试的所有“最后可见时刻速度衰减”策略都无法超越这一水平。
tldr: 本文通过广播视角基准测试发现，速度信息在无球分析的插补层几乎无用，对控制曲面具有一阶重要性（占误差的11-15%），对球队判定的影响小十倍，真正关键的是画面内可见球员的速度，完美还原被遮挡球员速度仅带来2-6%的额外增益。
en_tdlr: Through a broadcast-viewport benchmark, this paper shows that velocity is nearly useless for off-screen imputation, first-order important for the pitch control surface (11-15% of MAE), and ten times less impactful for team verdicts, with the visible channel dominating—perfect occluded-player velocity adds only 2-6% of the visible gain.
